intro: Numbered practices, not dates — a rainout moves everything down one instead of skipping it. Built one practice at a time, in teaching order: nothing gets installed before its prerequisite is in place.

preseason.label: Before the first game
preseason.note: Alignment first, plays second — every kid knows his spot and we count seven on the line before anybody touches the ball. A formation run without thinking beats six plays half known.

season.label: Once the season starts
season.note: One new look at a time, and only once the last one has hurt somebody. Each exists because a defence started cheating something — not worth installing before that happens.

practices.focus: Line up in the Regular I
practices.emphasis: Install the formation itself — alignment only, no plays. Every kid knows his spot, and we count seven on the line every single snap until it is boring.
practices.finisher: Gold vs. Purple sprint relay race.

practices.focus: Line up in the Regular I again
practices.emphasis: The same formation install. Reps on alignment and the seven-on-the-line count until they can do it without thinking — then we are ready to hand somebody the ball.
practices.finisher: Gold vs. Purple sprint relay race.
